description: This file defines the TimeDate class within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace, which manages time synchronization via DVB tuner signals, including internal classes for notification handling and section parsing, and methods for scanning, loading, and managing tuner states.

classes.name: TimeDate
classes.description: Manages DVB tuner time synchronization, including scanning and loading time data from DVB sections.

classes.name: TimeDate::Sink
classes.description: Handles tuner notifications such as activation, deactivation, and state changes.

classes.name: TimeDate::Parser
classes.description: Parses DVB sections related to time data, manages filtering of sections.

methods.name: TimeDate::TimeDate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TimeDate object and registers the sink with the tuner.

methods.name: TimeDate::~TimeDate
methods.description: Destructor that unregisters the sink from the tuner.

methods.name: TimeDate::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for DVB time sections.

methods.name: TimeDate::Deactivated
methods.description: Handles tuner deactivation events, removing the tuner from internal tracking.

methods.name: TimeDate::StateChange
methods.description: Handles tuner state changes, adding or removing tuners from internal tracking based on their state.

methods.name: TimeDate::Load
methods.description: Loads time data from DVB TDT or TOT sections.
